prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic cafe sponsorship campaign photograph, landscape 3:2, high resolution. Three distinctive Indian specialty drinks in clear tall takeaway cups with flat clear lids, arranged as an elegant studio still life on a seamless pale lilac background. Center hero larger iced filter coffee with beautiful amber espresso and milk marbling, left ruby kokum lime cooler with ice and small lime garnish, right cocoa banana milkshake. All cups have crisp ivory paper bands with ONLY the lowercase word "katte" in large heavy dark forest green sans serif, and tiny words "SPECIALTY DRINK". Center coffee band has a small burnt orange circle. Balanced composition with cups fully in frame, realistic condensation, clear liquid textures, soft directional shadows, strong editorial product lighting, clean art direction, no extra objects, no other brands, no slogans or labels outside cups. This is a concept visualization, not an existing venue. Colors lilac #CCC3EB, ivory #F7F3E8, burnt orange #B84F24, dark green #18271F. Cups occupy 80 percent of height. No people.

Use case: product-mockup. Premium editorial product photograph for Katte cafe annual specialty drink sponsorship deck. Portrait 4:5 composition. One beautiful clear takeaway cup of jaggery iced filter coffee with flat transparent lid, rich dark coffee blending into creamy milk, ice, fine realistic condensation. Crisp wide ivory paper sleeve wraps cup, printed with exact large lowercase heavy dark green text "katte" and beneath small "YOUR BRAND HERE". The cup stands on a low solid pale lilac cylindrical plinth against seamless pale warm ivory background, a small pool of soft shadow. Studio lighting like an expensive food magazine, extremely realistic textures. Restrained graphic design, no other text, no existing third-party logos, no people, no decorative ingredients. Whole cup in frame with generous margin. Hero cup fills about 75 percent height. Color palette ivory #F7F3E8 lilac #CCC3EB green #18271F.

Use case: product-mockup. Premium editorial cafe campaign photograph for Katte, portrait 4:5. A single chilled ruby red kokum-lime specialty cooler in a tall clear takeaway cup with flat transparent lid, beautiful ice cubes, subtle mint leaf and lime slice inside, realistic condensation. An ivory band with exact lowercase bold dark green word "katte" and smaller "YOUR BRAND HERE". Solid seamless warm burnt orange background with matching orange tabletop, art directed studio lighting and soft directional shadow. One cup only, no floating objects, no additional text, no people, no existing brand logos. Whole cup fully visible at 75 percent height, high detail, modern playful premium cafe identity. Orange #B84F24 ivory #F7F3E8 deep green #18271F.

Edit this Katte iced coffee product mockup for an explicitly hypothetical OpenAI sponsorship proposal. Preserve the exact cup, realistic jaggery coffee and milk, lid, lighting, ivory background, lilac plinth, camera framing. Change only the printed sleeve design: large elegant black sans serif text "OpenAI" centered on upper half; below it in smaller bold type "PROMPT & POUR"; at bottom small lowercase "katte". Do NOT include any knot symbol or other logo. All text must be exact and legible. This is a proposed brand collaboration, no endorsement claim or other added text. Keep photographic quality and paper texture.

Create a new wide 16:9 editorial campaign photo using the supplied drink as the exact product reference: same iced jaggery filter coffee, ivory paper sleeve with exact black "OpenAI", "PROMPT & POUR", "katte" typography. Show two of these cups together as a playful premium cafe still life on a seamless pale lilac studio background and tabletop. One cup upright at left-middle, one cup upright slightly behind on right on a low ivory cylinder. Cups fully in frame, no cut-off edges. Beautiful real marbling coffee/milk, ice and condensation. Soft strong editorial sunlight shadows. Big generous negative space at top. No people, no other text, no props or real venue. Photo should look tangible and delicious; cool lilac and warm coffee contrast. This is an illustrative proposed sponsorship, not an existing partnership.
